annotations.title: Liquidity pool check: a Base DEX pair's liquidity, volume, trades and age before trading

description: Check a Base DEX pool before you trade or add liquidity: give a pair address and get the verified DEX, both tokens, reported liquidity, 24h volume and trades, and pair age from DexScreener, with source and retrieval time. Missing fields are null; an unknown pair returns 404. Market data only, no pool-security or investment-risk assessment. Use to confirm a pair is real and deep enough before trading; token red flags: token_report. Example: address=0x98c7A2338336d2d354663246F64676009c7bDa97. Price $0.03/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

address.description: DEX pair address on Base, 0x-prefixed 20-byte hex
